brief.experience: A relaxed browser builder with a readable overhead view
brief.style: Muted palette, soft building silhouettes and clear zoning

settings.geometry: Rounded block silhouettes for structures; keep roads and placement markers distinct
settings.lighting: Low-contrast diffuse lighting is an editorial proposal, not a supplied shader
settings.camera: Reuse the target camera and controls ownership; map-like pan/dolly interaction

templates.reason: MapControls specializes OrbitControls for map-style panning; rounded boxes provide a reusable soft block silhouette.
templates.tradeoff: No zoning, construction, simulation clock or economy is supplied. MapControls includes an OrbitControls source dependency; inspect target camera/input ownership.

brief.experience: A small free-flight browser landscape explorer
brief.style: Large terrain shapes and atmospheric depth

settings.geometry: Use noise as an input to caller-owned terrain generation; broad forms before detail
settings.lighting: Haze and depth cues are editorial suggestions, not bundled assets
settings.camera: FlyControls owns a selected object’s movement; coordinate policy and bounds remain explicit

templates.reason: FlyControls provides free-flight input, while SimplexNoise can take a caller-controlled random source for repeatable terrain sampling.
templates.tradeoff: No aircraft physics, collisions, generated terrain mesh or game loop is included. Unseeded randomness does not establish deterministic worlds.
